feedback.unbacked_mirror: ein gespiegeltes CDN-Asset in phi/sources.φ muss seine Basis benennen — eine origin-Zeile (die öffentliche Quelle) oder eine terms-Zeile (Einwilligung/Lizenz); die Basis ist nie implizit. feedback.dimensionless-force: a field line declares the dimensionless unit "1" under a force whose registry (allowed_units_for_force) does not list it — em/gravity/diffusion/electric carry dimensionless shares (signal level, detection statistic, mixing ratio/pH, fraction), the remaining media do not, so the value is a statistic, not a field
feedback.burn-line-absent: a living handover carries no `## Burn: open <usd> · close <usd>` — the session cost is a mandatory field; add the measured line (session_burn at open and close)
feedback.burn-over-cap: the handover's close burn exceeds the effective cap — the session ran over budget; the default cap is 0.15 USD (the heavy-tail threshold: the four sessions over $0.15 carried 70% of the burn), or the raised cap declared on the burn line
feedback.burn-cap-unreasoned: a raised burn cap must carry a reason — a declared cap without a Grund is self-consent, not a measured exception
feedback.burn-cap-above-hard: a raised burn cap exceeds the hard ceiling 0.5 USD
feedback.promised-gate: a prose self-law (a hard cap or a self-imposed gate) claimed in the text without an enforcing mechanism is a promise, not a gate — carry the mechanism (opencode.json deny / gate rule) or strike the line
